acceptance_checks.given: Calendar add and close controls are rendered
acceptance_checks.when: Their icon geometry and keyboard focus are inspected
acceptance_checks.then: Registered SVG icons are centered in shared hit areas with visible focus and accessible names
acceptance_checks.verify_method: Rendered geometry and screenshots; keyboard inspection

acceptance_checks.when: Title blurs or another composer field receives interaction
acceptance_checks.then: No required-title error appears before intentional submission
acceptance_checks.verify_method: Focused composer regression and browser interaction

acceptance_checks.when: Opening pointer completes, then cancel, Escape, or click-outside is exercised
acceptance_checks.then: Opening leaves it open and each normal dismissal closes it without title errors
acceptance_checks.verify_method: Focused composer regression and browser interaction

acceptance_checks.given: Invalid, meaningful, saving, or failed event drafts
acceptance_checks.when: Intentional save or dismissal is attempted
acceptance_checks.then: Validation prevents invalid persistence; meaningful and saving drafts retain guards; actual failures remain visible
acceptance_checks.verify_method: Focused composer regression for validation, guard, and persistence paths

acceptance_checks.given: Sidebar in light and dark appearance
acceptance_checks.when: Navigation and task context are displayed
acceptance_checks.then: Rail surface is continuous without harsh context, utility or footer bands and selected state stays legible
acceptance_checks.verify_method: Desktop light and dark screenshots with narrow-layout spot checks

acceptance_checks.given: Settings and Notifications in the Jin header utility group
acceptance_checks.when: Pointer or keyboard activates them at normal, narrow or increased-text layouts
acceptance_checks.then: Existing guarded routes, translated accessible names, unread state and reachable controls remain functional
acceptance_checks.verify_method: Browser route and keyboard checks; unread-state inspection; responsive screenshots
